verdict.rationale: Reflect has no native, user-configurable automation or agent feature. Background automation comes from Zapier (an external tool) and the OAuth API, which can append data and return bookmarks. A few fixed built-in background behaviours exist: automatic Kindle sync, background audio transcription into the daily note, and automatic daily-note creation. Missing for 10: native user-defined automations or triggers, scheduled or agentic AI tasks that run without user invocation, and hands-on evidence of autonomous workflows in practice.
